notes.title: Shaman update & St. Patrick’s Day
notes.notes:
🍀 Wherever you go, whatever you do, may the luck of the Irish be there with you! 🍀

Spring is just around the corner, and there’s no better way to celebrate the return of all the greenery than with the most green and gold event of them all! The St. Patrick’s Day event is back with more prizes than ever, are you feeling lucky enough to collect them all?

Collect the three different types of lucky trinkets on maps while you play and visit Cassidy at the Ol' Souris bar to trade in for some shamrockin’ new prizes, including a new badge, new cartouche, new hairstyle, and a new consumable!

That new hairstyle Cassidy is offering seems mighty familiar though…

In addition, the most experienced shamans can now try a new difficulty setting by deactivating the shaman skills. In doing so, the experience gained is increased by 30% and the shaman currency gains by 50%.

- Rooms with "shaman" in their name no longer activate the "aie" mode.
- Added 3 new stats in the profile for the shaman mode without skill.
- In mode without skill, the nail arrows are disabled. Depending on the feedback, they may come back.
- [lua] Added targetPlayer parameter to tfm.exec.addNPC().
